title: Automate changelog and onboard cygnus-13b-v1.0 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Maya Chen
description:
Onboard Cygnus-13B v1.0 into the model registry and wire up automated changelog/release note generation. Motivation: Cygnus is a community model we want to expose in the catalog with verified performance profiles and metadata so runtime routing and Dedicated customers can opt in. This PR adds the model metadata and performance profiles (single-file, multi-config), integrates the model onboarding into the changelog automation pipeline, and includes a lightweight integration test and docs page.

What this PR does: 1) Adds models/cygnus/metadata.json (model card, licensing, tokenizer info, recommended quantization). 2) Adds models/cygnus/perf_profiles.yaml (perf profiles for ampere/p4/quantized configs with throughput/latency baselines). 3) Adds docs/models/cygnus.md with quickstart and known limitations. 4) Adds tests/integration/test_cygnus_perf.py that validates generated perf metrics against expected thresholds in CI. 5) Extends scripts/generate_changelog.py to pick up model-registry changes and auto-insert release notes entries following the standard template. 6) Updates ci/pipelines/model-registry.yml to run the new perf integration job and publish changelog artifacts.

Notes and constraints: - Perf profiles were collected on A100 and T4 (quantized) testbeds; numbers are recorded in the perf_profiles.yaml and include sampling metadata. - Changelog automation appends a release note entry under 'Model registry' with model name, version, and short notes; the script is idempotent and guarded by a feature flag (AUTO_CHANGELOG=true). - Sensitive fields (exact training data pointers) are intentionally omitted from metadata.json per policy.

Testing: local unit tests + integration perf test in CI. Manual verification: inspected generated changelog fragment and validated it renders correctly in the release-notes preview tool.

Risks: small risk of minor formatting differences in generated changelog affecting downstream release publishing; mitigated by adding a pipeline lint and preview step.

release_notes:

- Added performance profiles for A100 and T4 (quantized) with baseline latency and throughput.
- Automated changelog/release note generation for model-registry changes (feature flag AUTO_CHANGELOG).
